name: readme-presentation
body:
README.md is presented as kalide's polished front page. At the top is a brand hero: the kalide mark (`brand/logo_light.svg` / `brand/logo_dark.svg`, switched via GitHub `<picture>` + `prefers-color-scheme`) with the name ""kalide"" as lowercase Helvetica-styled text. Next to the hero, the README gives the name's etymology — kalide is a portmanteau of Greek *kalón* (καλόν), the ideal of the beautiful and the good, and *slide* (wording per solution.system.kalide, no further claims) — and a pronunciation guide: said like ""collide"" (kuh-LIDE). Right after these comes a light, playful line (one or two sentences, gentle and self-aware, not snarky or overdone). It conveys that while kalide is perhaps not quite as pedantic as the ancient Greeks, it does believe slides look better when they're consistent, tying the name to the product's philosophy of strict templates and no per-slide styling (global.constraint.no-per-slide-styling). The implementer may polish the wording but keeps the meaning and tone. The name is always written lowercase (""kalide""), consistent with the brand wordmark. Headings, badges and sections are styled consistently. All existing technical content is retained: the Install section (front-loaded per readme-install-front-loading), usage, CLI reference and table of contents.

The README also documents the current user-facing template-format features, so the human-facing front page stays level with the format rather than only the agent guide: the layout helper set — `media`, `section`, `dict` and `list` (template-language, section-helper, dict-list-helpers) — and the reserved read-only contexts — `.deck`, `.slide`, `.item`, `.raw` and `.data` (template-context, item-context, raw-source-context, section-data-context) — with the reserved top-level names `deck`/`slide`/`item`/`raw`/`data` (requirements.constraint.reserved-template-names). A user-facing format feature is not shipped until the README documents it: the README is the counterpart of the AGENTS.md deck guide (agent-authoring) for human readers, and a format feature that appears only in the guide and the template language leaves the front page stale (e.g. the README must not state a smaller helper set or fewer reserved contexts than the format actually provides).

AC: README.md opens with a hero that references `brand/logo_dark.svg` and/or `brand/logo_light.svg`, both of which exist in the repo; near the top it states the etymology (kalón/καλόν, the beautiful and the good, + slide) and that kalide is pronounced like ""collide"" (kuh-LIDE); the etymology passage includes the playful consistency line; the name appears in lowercase throughout the prose; the table of contents still resolves to every section; the Install section covers tap/bucket, install, upgrade and manual download (no token step); a link to LICENSE and CHANGELOG.md is present; the README documents the layout helper set as `media`/`section`/`dict`/`list` and the reserved contexts `.deck`/`.slide`/`.item`/`.raw`/`.data` (and the reserved names `deck`/`slide`/`item`/`raw`/`data`), matching template-language, section-helper, dict-list-helpers, template-context, item-context, raw-source-context and section-data-context — it does not describe a smaller helper set or fewer reserved contexts than the format provides.
